name: std::filesystem::path::c_str, std::filesystem::path::native, std::filesystem::path::operator string_type()
intro:
Accesses the native path name as a character string.

1) Equivalent to native().c_str().

2) Returns the native-format representation of the pathname by reference.

3) Returns the native-format representation of the pathname by value.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The native string representation of the pathname, using native syntax, native character type, and native character encoding. This string is suitable for use with OS APIs.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: The conversion function (3) is provided so that APIs that accept std::basic_string file names can use pathnames with no changes to code.

summary: Accesses the native path name as a character string.
